redfin.remarks: Welcome To This Pool Home In Lancaster! A light-filled home on a very large lot, in a well-established Lancaster neighborhood. This home offers a smart layout and an easy flow open plan with high vaulted ceilings that’s ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step into a warm, welcoming main living area with generous space for relaxing or hosting guests. A cozy fireplace anchors the space, creating the perfect setting. The first floor offers a convenient bedroom, 1/2 bathroom, and indoor laundry room, providing flexibility for guests, family members, or a home office. The kitchen offers ample granite countertops and cabinetry. In addition, the kitchen offers a seamless connection to the dining and family room area where French patio doors connects to the spacious backyard that leads to a sparkling fenced pool and outdoor bar patio. The backyard also includes double storage sheds and plenty of space to create a garden oasis of your very own. Upstairs offers a spacious master bedroom with a private nook area for a desk or lounge seating, walk in closet, and vanity area included in the master bedroom/bathroom area. In addition there are 2 additional bedrooms upstairs with newly installed floors and full bathroom. The property also features a desert landscape, ample driveway and garage parking, and potential to upgrade for RV parking adding everyday convenience. Located near local schools, shopping, dining, parks, and major commuter routes, this home combines comfort, accessibility, and long-term value—an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, move-up buyers, or investors in the growing Antelope Valley market.
